column1: # KIT12 draft: H-1 stage table for drive.sh KIND=h1, read with run-h1.conf. Not a stage table yet: drive.sh refuses
# a row with an @@NAME@@ left in it before any box (test-drive-h1.sh H21). Columns (tab-separated): BOX KIND TYPE
# EST_FAST_H EST_SLOW_H SLOW_OK NEEDS SPEC TTL_H PARTS. Sources: the spec paths and SAL-1/SAL-2 split are repo
# docs/input-comparison-runner.md (H-1 specs); kinds, types and the combine rows follow drive.sh's header (a combine
# box is type default and waits for its parts' DONE); TTL_H is the slow estimate + 0.5 h (G6, no resume) and at most
# 6 h (MAX_TTL). KIT12: each main part leaves out k21 and k25, and each runs on its own addon box (column 10 names the
# main part; G2(b), Layth's ruling of 8 Nov 2026 lifting register section 13 G2); each species' combine takes its
# main parts and their add-ons. MTB is in (Layth, 8 Nov 2026: all four species). No hour estimate, SLOW_OK or run-box
# ordering is on this controller, so those are placeholders.
